selected_scope.finding: Provenance-safe Vanilla V81 evidence now proves a position-based MouthDogAI noise path through DetectNoise/noisePositionGuess and a separate generic MouthDogAI.OnCollideWithEnemy(Collider, EnemyAI) lunge/damage path. Exact LethalMin 1.1.108 evidence proves PikminAI inherits EnemyAI and can emit RoundManager.PlayAudibleNoise at its own position while the accepted config has Dont Make Audible Noises=false. A Purple Pikmin did carry GoldBar(Clone), but the carried GoldBar itself as the causal Mouth Dog noise source is not yet proved or excluded. S1.42AG remains rejected; reverse-direction Pikmin -> Mouth Dog combat remains a future deliberate runtime gate.
